rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. It proceeded to cancel the order without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user’s request was conditional (check if the camera is 10x zoom; if not, modify; if unavailable, cancel; if available but >3000, cancel with a different reason). The agent did not present any findings about the product’s zoom, availability of a 10x variant, or price, nor did it attempt the requested modification. It also did not explicitly authenticate the user beyond looking up by email, and it provided a refund timeline without tool support. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and the outcome is a fail.
